positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerification
positions.frame: how was the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration established and what verifies it?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the calibration at 88.4 MHz, src-2 verifies it against June reference plates across the full observing band, and src-3 declaratively recaps both as key decisions — all three cohere under the read of how the calibration was established and what evidence supports it.
